reading.zh: 从左到右：ids 生成实体标识，uncertainty 记录不确定度，entity 描述实体，event 记录事件，store 汇总存取；箭头表示状态自描述流向存储。
reading.en: Left to right: ids mints entity ids, uncertainty records confidence, entity describes entities, event records events and store ties storage together; arrows carry the described state into storage.
